datasets.purpose: Acute Food Insecurity Classifications data in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Sudan to classify acute food insecurity conditions using standardized classification scales. Data were collected in multiple scenarios and compiled into a national dataset with temporal coverage from 2018, providing post-event or current-situation food security impact assessments.
